title: 阿木木·抱抱靠垫
description: 绿色绷带小木乃伊抱住柔软靠垫，身旁摆着一只小布偶，画面温柔而不阴森。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Amumu is a tiny childlike mummy figure completely wrapped in soft green bandages, with a very large rounded head, small dark eye openings, and a short compact body. Preserve the recognizable winding cloth layers and a loose bandage tail, but make the face tender and quietly hopeful. Avoid exposed remains or frightening details; the bandages fully enclose his little silhouette.
art_direction.scene: Place him on a large floor cushion beside a tiny stitched toy, hugging a soft round pillow with both small arms. One bandage end curls harmlessly across the rug like a ribbon. A low window and a single flower in a cup provide a friendly room. His eyes look toward the toy with gentle companionship.
art_direction.palette: moss green, mint, soft peach, warm ivory
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
